title: Interim Assistant Accountant
description:
As an Interim Assistant Accountant in Wrexham, you'll play a key role in supporting a growing finance team. Your day-to-day will include managing financial records, assisting with reports, and ensuring smooth financial operations.

Client Details

A growing organisation based in Wrexham with new modernised offices, offering plenty of facilities.

Description
- Maintain accurate financial records and update accounting systems.
- Assist in preparing financial reports and budgets.
- Support month-end and year-end processes.
- Reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies.
- Process invoices and manage supplier payments.
- Assist with audits and ensure compliance with financial regulations.
- Provide administrative support to the finance team as required.

Profile

A successful Assistant Accountant should have:
- Previous experience in an accounting or finance role.
- Ideally studying towards professional accountancy qualifications.
- Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial processes.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.

- Fixed-term contract with the possibility of further opportunities.
- Great benefits package including private healthcare.

- Accessible location both for public transport and free parking on site.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Michael Page are delighted to be partnering with a successful and growing manufacturing business in Wrexham to recruit a Credit Controller into their established finance team. This is an excellent opportunity to join a market-leading organisation supplying products to some of the UK's best-known brands. The business offers a supportive, collaborative culture where individuals are given ownership, responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact

Client Details

Reporting to the AR leader, you'll take ownership of a portfolio of key accounts, managing the full credit control process whilst ensuring cash collection targets are achieved and customer accounts remain accurate and up to date. This role would suit an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys building relationships, resolving complex queries and working within a fast-paced FMCG, manufacturing or distribution environment.

Description

The key responsibilities of the Credit Controller include:
- Managing and maximising cash collection across a portfolio of major retail customers.
- Building strong working relationships with customer accounts teams and navigating retailer payment portals.
- Investigating and resolving invoice disputes, short payments and deductions.
- Reconciling high-volume sales ledger accounts, ensuring timely allocation of cash, credits and debits.
- Monitoring retailer rebates, promotional deductions and trade spend claims.
- Working closely with commercial, logistics and supply chain teams to resolve queries efficiently.
- Providing aged debt reporting, cashflow forecasts and updates on outstanding disputes.
- Ensuring invoices are successfully submitted and processed through EDI and customer systems.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Previous experience within a Credit Control position.
- Exposure to FMCG, manufacturing, wholesale or distribution businesses.
- Experience dealing with large retail customers and supermarket portals.
- Strong reconciliation and query resolution skills.
- Good Excel skills, including VLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables.
- Experience using ERP systems and EDI platforms.
- A proactive, resilient and relationship-focused approach.

Job Offer
- Salary up to £32,000
- Hybrid working model after a settling-in period, with three days in the office.
- Permanent contract in a stable industry.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Your new company
You will be working with a growing education provider in the Wrexham area.
Your new role
Working in a large HR and People Operations function, you will provide administrative support to HR Officers and the wider team! Based on site in Wrexham, you will be assisting with a range of administrative duties, such as right to work checks, processing of DBS checks where necessary, updating and maintaining personnel and employee information, processing sick leave and parental leave, responding to administrative enquiries from a shared inbox, as well as maintaining accurate records on the HR database! Your remit will include processing ad hoc BACS payments when necessary, as well as offboarding paperwork such as P45 requests.
What you'll need to succeed
Prior experience as a HR administrator or a HR assistant will be essential to hit the ground running for this post! Ideally, you will be experienced in all administrative duties for on and offboarding processes, ER considerations and be used to maintaining databases with discretion. You will be using your excellent attention to detail daily to ensure processes are conducted appropriately, and be comfortable putting your strong communication skills to good use daily in written and verbal formats. You will be immediately available and be able to bring your positive work attitude at short notice! You must be locally situated to Wrexham for this site based role.
What you'll get in return
Working for 9 months with a local employer of choice, you will have a stable temporary contract which will take you through to Summer of 2027. You will have access to free on site parking, excellent on site amenities, and full time hours for the duration! You will have a pay rate of 14.50ph

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Administrator
description:
I am currently working with an established and small family run accountancy firm that are looking for an experienced administrator that has an excellent attention to detail and that is highly organised for a pivotal role in the business

The company is open to an office/ hybrid role once full training has been given.

Role: Administrator

Job Description

Type: Permanent, Full-Time (part-time considered also)

Location: Office-based/ Hybrid Wrexham

The company is an highly established accountancy firm:

We are a friendly and professional small accountancy practice providing bookkeeping, payroll, tax, and accounting services to a wide range of local businesses and individuals. We pride ourselves on delivering excellent customer service and building long-term relationships with our clients.

The Role

We are seeking a highly organised and reliable General Administration Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of our busy accountancy office. The successful candidate will help ensure the smooth running of administrative functions while providing excellent service to clients and supporting the accounting team.

Key Responsibilities
- Answering telephone calls and directing enquiries appropriately.
- Greeting clients and visitors in a professional and friendly manner.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post and emails.
- Maintaining client records and ensuring information is up to date.
- Preparing, scanning, filing, and archiving documents both electronically and in paper format.
- Assisting with the preparation and distribution of client correspondence.
- Scheduling appointments and managing staff diaries.
- Supporting the team with administrative tasks relating to accounts, tax returns, payroll, and bookkeeping services.
- Ordering office supplies and maintaining office organisation.
- Assisting with data entry and updating practice management systems.
- Ensuring confidentiality and compliance with data protection requirements.

Skills and Experience

Essential:
- Previous administration or office experience.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, and Excel.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently.
- Professional and friendly approach when dealing with clients.

Desirable:
- Experience working in an accountancy, legal, financial services, or professional services environment.
- Knowledge of accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks, Sage, or similar.

title: Unison Branch Administrator
description:
Adecco are pleased to be recruiting for a Unison Branch Administrator to work within the North Wales Police Force

Our client, a prominent organisation in the public services sector, is seeking a dedicated Unison Branch Administrator to join their team in Colwyn Bay. This part-time 18.5 hours per week Monday to Friday role offers an hourly rate of 14.10 per hour and is set to run until March, 2027. The successful candidate will play a key role in providing essential administrative support to the North Wales Police UNISON Branch.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Unison Branch Administrator, the responsibilities will include:
- Performing general administrative duties such as word processing, formatting documents, and managing diaries.
- Responding to inquiries from both internal and external sources with professionalism and efficiency.
- Organising, scheduling, and attending events, meetings, and conferences for the North Wales Police and UNISON.
- Preparing agendas and taking minutes to ensure smooth communication within the organisation.
- Making travel arrangements for branch officers and representatives, utilising the Atriis system.
- Managing and distributing UNISON information leaflets and merchandise.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring confidentiality in accordance with policies and procedures.

Requirements:

Our client is looking for candidates who can demonstrate:
- An NVQ Level 3 in Administration or equivalent experience.
- Intermediate IT skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and a typing speed of at least 35wpm.
- Strong communication skills, essential for effective interaction with various stakeholders.
- Previous experience in providing administrative support, including meeting preparation and minute-taking.
- A proactive attitude, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- Teamwork capabilities, as well as the ability to work independently using one's initiative.

Why Consider This Role?

An opportunity to contribute to a vital organisation dedicated to public service.
A supportive work environment that values professionalism and efficiency.
The chance to develop and enhance administrative skills within a dynamic team.

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for administrative support and a commitment to delivering high-quality service, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

title: Operations & Fulfilment Coordinator (Part Time)
description:
Job Description Operations Coordinator

Role at a glance

Hours:- 24 Hours per week, three full days, or spread across Monday to Friday by agreement

Location:- Flint, Mainly on site, with scope for some hybrid working once established

Salary:- £15.25 p/h

Contract:- Permanent, Part Time

About us

We are a small team where everyone's work matters and good ideas are acted on quickly.

The role

This is a hands-on role that combines purchasing, order administration and warehouse work. You will make sure customer orders are bought in, checked, packed and dispatched correctly and on time.

Over time you will take ownership of the day-to-day operational work currently handled by the Director, so that problems are picked up and solved without needing to be escalated.

For the successful candidate there will be growth opportunities.

Key responsibilities

Purchasing
- Raise purchase orders from the sales orders and check them for accuracy.
- Send purchase orders to our manufacturers with the required due dates.
- Check order confirmations against the dates and prices. Chase corrections where needed and update the system.
- Keep prices on purchase orders accurate and up to date.

Sales orders and dispatch
- Liaise with customers on product specifications and order details, working with the Directors where needed.
- Adjust and finalise sales orders so they are correct and ready to invoice before dispatch.

Warehouse
- Handle goods in and goods out.
- Carry out quality checks, pack orders for dispatch.

Technical support
- Help with pre-wiring of equipment. Training will be given.
- Cover warehouse and technical tasks during colleagues' holidays.

Continuous improvement
- Follow our established processes accurately.
- Look for better ways of working and suggest improvements. Good ideas will become part of how we work.

About you

Essential
- At least 2 years' experience in a similar role, such as purchasing, order processing, operations or warehouse coordination.
- A proven track record of solving problems and getting things right first time.
- Experience improving or correcting working procedures.
- A practical, hands-on approach, and happy to move between desk work and the warehouse.
- Sound judgement and the confidence to make sensible decisions without constant supervision.
- Strong attention to detail, especially with dates, prices and order information.
- Confident using computers, order or stock systems, and email.
- Open to trying new ways of working, and able to challenge existing methods constructively.

Desirable
- Experience with Unleashed or a similar ERP system.
- Knowledge of electrical or engineering sector.
- Forklift licence, or willing to train.

What we offer
- £15.25 per hour for 24 hours per week.
- Flexible hours pattern: three full days, or shorter days across the week.
- Scope for some hybrid working once you are established.
- Training in our products, systems and processes, including pre-wiring.
- A varied role in a small team where your ideas shape how the business runs.
- Workplace pension.

title: CAMHS Administrator
description: The ability to speak Welsh is desirable for this post; however, applications are welcomed from both Welsh and English speakers. We are seeking to recruit an enthusiastic and motivated individual to provide accurate, efficient, and effective administrative support to Children and Young People's Services within the East area. The successful candidate will possess a good standard of education, excellent communication skills, and a professional telephone manner, with the ability to communicate confidently with people at all levels. They will be organised, proactive, and capable of managing their workload effectively, using their own initiative to meet competing priorities and deadlines. Previous experience working in a busy office environment is essential, particularly in settings with frequent interruptions, high workloads, and conflicting demands. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong keyboard and IT skills, including experience using Microsoft Office applications. The ability to maintain a professional, sensitive, and confidential approach at all times is essential. Experience of audio typing would be advantageous. The Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service (CAMHS) Administrative Assistant will provide efficient, effective, and flexible administrative support to the service. Key responsibilities will include copy typing, managing electronic and paper-based diaries, coordinating appointments, and supporting the day-to-day administrative functions of the team. The post holder may also be required to undertake reception duties as needed. Due to the nature of the role, the post holder will be expected to maintain strict confidentiality at all times and handle sensitive information appropriately. They will interact with patients, carers, family members, medical staff, colleagues, and visitors both in person and in writing, demonstrating professionalism, courtesy, and discretion in all communications. The post holder will work under the guidance of the Administration Manager, who will be available to provide support, advice, and direction as required.
